The vendor directly providing the **Buzzsprout** podcast hosting product at **buzzsprout.com** is **Higher Pixels, Inc.** (doing business as **Buzzsprout**).

### Supporting Evidence
* **Buzzsprout Privacy Policy (`buzzsprout.com/privacy`):**  
  > *"Higher Pixels, dba Buzzsprout, provides the Buzzsprout product (www.buzzsprout.com) and Buzzsprout Ads (www.buzzsprout.com/ads), together referred to as the Buzzsprout Services."*

* **Buzzsprout Terms of Service (`buzzsprout.com/tos`):**  
  > *"Higher Pixels provides Buzzsprout and its related services ('Service') subject to your compliance with the terms and conditions ('Terms of Service')..."*

* **Buzzsprout Data Privacy Framework Policy (`buzzsprout.com/dpf`):**  
  > *"Buzzsprout is owned and operated by Higher Pixels, Inc. Higher Pixels is a small web application company based in Jacksonville, Florida, USA."*

Buzzsprout operates in the digital media space and caters to both novice and experienced podcasters.
